bg_ctx_translate.description: Context menu item on selected text. Keep %s: Chrome replaces it with the selection.

bg_ctx_image.description: Context menu item on images: recognizes the text in the image (OCR) and translates it

bg_ctx_area.description: Context menu item on pages: drag to select an area of the screen, its text is recognized and translated

bg_ctx_site_off.description: Toolbar icon context menu. $1 = website hostname, e.g. example.com

bg_ctx_site_on.description: Toolbar icon context menu (site is currently disabled). $1 = website hostname

bg_ctx_site_unavailable.description: Toolbar icon context menu, shown greyed out when the current page can't be identified (e.g. chrome:// pages)

bg_ctx_pause.vi: Tạm dừng TransPop trên mọi trang
bg_ctx_pause.description: Toolbar icon context menu: turn off in-page translation globally

bg_ctx_resume.vi: Bật lại TransPop trên mọi trang
bg_ctx_resume.description: Toolbar icon context menu: turn in-page translation back on

bg_badge_off.description: Toolbar badge while in-page translation is paused (max 4 characters)

bg_action_title_paused.vi: TransPop — đang tạm dừng (đã tắt dịch trên trang)
